description: National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) claims: flood losses and insurance payouts by state, county, ZIP, year and named flood event. Each claim has damage, building/contents/ICC payments, coverage, flood zone and water depth; the summary totals the payments shown. The count covers all matching claims.

flood_event.description: Storm or event name, e.g. 'Harvey', 'Ian', 'Atmospheric River', in any capitalization. Words like 'Hurricane' or 'Tropical Storm' are dropped, since FEMA writes recent events as '2025-08-Erin-HU'. A one-word name matches whole words ('Earl' is not 'Early'), or inside names if no event has it as a word ('Kona' in '2026-03-KonaStorm'); longer names match anywhere. Add year_from/year_to when a name was reused.

sort_by.description: 'date' (newest first, default) or 'paid' (largest building payment first)

state.description: State name, two-letter code or FIPS code: 'Texas', 'TX', '48'

name: fema_nfip_claims
